newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse firmly ahead on Dow gains.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse firmly ahead on Dow gains.

text.p: 1245 GMT - German shares end bourse dealings strongly ahead, powered by overnight gains on Wall Street and in U.S. Treasuries, which also boosted German Bunds. Settlement of DAX future contract and last trading day for constituent stock options also helps gains, dealers say.
* 30-share DAX ends up 46.70 points, 1.66 percent, at 2,854.45 points.
* March DAX future up 24.5 points at 2,872.5 points.
* Henkel ahead after Loctite merger gets German clearance, says to acquire rest of Schwarzkopf.
* Heavy volume in Siemens ahead of option expiry.
